balls.text: nearly nails the yorker, drilled hard, straight of long-on. Comes back for two
not the wide yorker but the straight full toss, and he has hit the middle stump. Beats him for pace. And for a change, this doesn't run away off the ricochet
nails the wide yorker this time, at 146ks. Oh the dreaded siren. Oh Dhoni's luck. The crowd is going wild. Big no-ball too
looks for the wide yorker. Goes too wide, and Dhoni doesn't shuffle. KKR have reviewed this, but I don't see how the third umpire can help them
the knowledgeable Chennai crowd roars. Jadeja has ramped a bouncer straight to short third. Now they get to see MS Dhoni for two balls
yorker, middle stump, worked wide of long-on, comes back for two
slower short ball, a bit of a top edge on the pull. Just the single
that's interesting. Drills a yorker straight to long-on, but Jadeja is hit on the ankle and they take two off the deflection. Would have been just one had Jadeja not got hit
back full and wide, and Dube gets just the single to long-off
another change-up delivery. Full and fast but on the pads. Tucks him up, and gets an inside edge onto the pad
slower bouncer for a change-up and concedes a wide on height
full and wide, single to long-on. Superb execution so far in this over. Can Thakur close it out well?
Thakur stays full and wide. Even though this is a low full toss, it goes just for a single to long-off
Thakur stays full and wide, Jadeja shuffles across and heaves this to wide long-on. Dube turns down the second
goes for the sweep, perhaps a touch too early as Thakur slips in a full wide fast delivery and a dot
slower this time but stays on the pads. Placed straight of deep midwicket, and they take another couple
short of a length, quick, punched wide of long-on for two
full, middle and leg, slow in the air, pushed towards deep midwicket for one
quick carrom ball on the pads, beats him down leg, but it is called a wide. And they charge off for a run off the fumble
stays outside leg, bowls an offbreak, but Dube this time clears the front leg, goes against the turn, and hits a flat six on the short side
on a length, turning in, pushed into the leg side for a single
quick, on the pads, beats him. Just the leg-bye. Or perhaps he has got an edge
wrong'un, on a length, middle and off, punched straight to cover-point
slow in the air, really full, drilled down to long-off for one
seam-up but too short, and Dube helps it on its way for a six over long leg. Unforced errors this over, and CSK have found momentum
this time he gets the edge but it is so thick that Gurbaz can't hold on to it. And oh oh. The dreaded siren. He has overstepped. Just the turning point CSK need?
appeal for a catch at the wicket, not given, and they have reviewed it. Wrong'un, on a length, well outside off, Jadeja goes for the cut, but he is clearly beaten. So KKR lose the review
long hop, Jadeja doesn't get all of it, and there is a deep square leg in place. The pull, though, clears the man comfortably
really full, can't get under it, dug out for a single to deep cover
slower ball, short of a length, 116ks, nudged to deep midwicket for one
quicker, fuller, 136ks, driven to long-off
slower ball, on a length, 116ks, beats his cut
short of a length, inside edge, single to short fine
on a length, angling across, a bit of a bottom edge back to Thakur
starts off short, skiddy but waist high, and Dube helps him around the corner for four. Sweeper behind square on the leg side is long leg
and beats Jadeja on defence. He is stretching forward but Varun is short of his reach, and gets some turn away
flighted just outside off, driven to deep cover for another single
short of a length, outside off, hit uppishly towards long-on for one
on a length, pitched outside leg, deflected into the leg side for one
short of a length, wide, cut away for one
short of a length, quick, punched to deep cover
really full, outside off, Jadeja stays deep in the crease, and plays it straight to cover
and back to googlies for Jadeja. Played back to Suyash this time
quick legbreak, Dube punches it to cover where an unnecessary throw allows them a single
wrong'un, on a length, outside leg, worked into the leg side for a single
full, seems like a legbreak, and Dube plays him down to long-on for one
quick wrong'un, jadeja opens the face, gets a single
flighted offbreak, he opens the face for a single, and Narine ends with 4-0-15-2
a quick carrom ball. Similar to the one that got Moeen. Just a touch shorter than that one, and Jadeja gets some bat on this
flighted around off, defended off the front foot
back to outside leg, turning towards off, punched to long-on for one
short of a length, offbreak, punched back to him
offbreak, outside leg. Again not giving Dube any room
full, middle and off, driven to long-off. Dube has not looked to play to leg even once. He is playing Suyash like an offspinner
too full, too wide, and Dube launches this over extra cover for six. The first boundary in 41 balls. Straight into the KKR cheerleaders
wrong'un, starts outside leg, ends up on off. Jadeja drops and runs, and makes it
pushes this one wide of cover for one
flighted, slower, middle and off, played to off, but straight to cover
spot-on wrong'un at 90ks. Dube plays the line, and is beaten. Does well not to follow it

the carrom ball, and he gone right through. Moeen is watching for the offbreak, but Narine has slipped in a quicker carrom ball. Beats the inside edge, and takes off and middle. One more wicket to Dhoni's batting
stays outside leg to deny Dube any room. Nudged to deep square for one
a touch fuller, outside leg, pushed wide of long-on for two
offbreak, middle and leg, on a length, defended
on a length, on off, pushed with an open face
and he has cleaned Rayudu up. Offbreak, Rayudu sweeps, beaten, and he has hit the top of off. What else can you ask of a bowler? The lack of boundaries of late showing in their shots
finally something close to being pitched up. Still on the shorter side of good length, gets an inside edge from Dube, and Gurbaz makes a diving save
Thakur stays short, enjoying the slowness and the variable responses from the pitch. Rayudu opens the face for a single to deep third
short again, 140ks, punched to deep point for a single
Thakur's golden arm strikes. A third short ball, 131ks this time. All different pace, and different bounce from the surface. This time he gets a top edge on the pull, and is caught at deep square leg
dug in short again, 137ks, hurries him and hits him in the thigh pad
starts with a bouncer at 129ks, crunched away, but there is a deep midwicket in place to keep them to one
flighted carrom ball, lobbed to the left of Narine. He is not diving for this, and it goes past the outstretched hand
offbreak, starts outside leg, deflected to leg for one
offbreak, sliding down, nudged away for one
carrom ball, turn towards off stump, defended back to him
big offbreak cramps Rayudu up as he looks to open the face on it
offbreak, on a length, punched to deep midwicket for one

Rahane with the right intent but his success rate against spin is not as good as against pace. He skips down the pitch looking for a straight six, but the carrom ball takes the thick outside edge for a catch to long-off
goes back to try to run a length ball behind square. Can't beat point
driven down to long-on for one
inside edge on a push, and the ball has reached the edge of the 30-yard circle, but they still steal a second

big appeal on the legbreak, given out, but I think it might be going down. Conway reviews. Bowled from around the wicket, but - my mistake - this is not a legbreak. Just the straighter one, which pitches just outside off, and beats his inside edge. The line os good, but to everyone's surprise, the ball tracking has it bouncing over. Looking back, it has hit Conway above the knee roll. Conway bats on
bottom edge on the cut, and they take a single
carrom ball, but Rahane's wrists still manage to work this to leg for one
another offbreak, a touch too short, punched down to long-on for another single
big offbreak, 89ks, pulled behind square for one
sees him advance, bowls slightly flatter and down leg, nudged away for one
slow in the air, wide outside off, 87ks, beats him with the offbreak
short of a length, outside off, punched down to long-on for one
wide yorker, dug out for another dot. Good finish from Arora
looks to launch this short ball over deep midwicket from outside off, but is early into the shot and is beaten
sharp bouncer, shoulder high, perhaps a little high, beats him on the pull
slower ball, on a length, 122ks, which is why the steer goes straight to deep point as opposed to behind square
punched straight to mid-off and steals a single
shimmies down, gets a thick inside edge, which actually helps him come back for two

this is the new Rahane. He doesn't respect good balls anymore. Gets under a length ball - perhaps a touch short of a length - and lofts it over mid-on. All he wants to do is clear the ring, and the timing carries it just over the fence
on a length, top of off, defended to cover
Rahane loves pace on the ball. Steers this wide of short third, and well left of deep point. Deft touch
bottom edge on the pull. Single to deep square
down the wicket, takes this on the half-volley, but the drive goes straight to extra cover
done in for pace and bounce. Hit in the thigh pad as he looks to work this length ball to leg
corrects both his line and length. Conway nudges it into the leg side for one
overpitches outside off with boundary riders on the leg side. Conway drives it between mid-off and extra cover
pats a low full toss down the ground for one

seems like it is the plan to go after CV Varun early, and it has backfired. A legbreak from Varun, which Gaikwad tries to slog. Don't think he has picked him from the hand. The ball turns, and takes a thick edge to short third
looks to go inside-out but the ball turns in to take the thick inside edge, which goes wide of mid-on for two
sweep shot first up. He has picked it from just outside off. Not sure he has got himself outside the line but it doesn't matter as he has middled it
now a valiant chase from Rinky Singh from deep square leg to deep midwicket as Conway flicks a straight ball. He gets there somehow but as he dives his boot flicks the boundary triangle
this is ridiculous. This inswinger has cramped him, Gaikwad gets a bottom edge straight to the keeper, and Conway has still called him through for one, and made it. This is ludicrously good running
inswinger, off-driven on the up, but straight to mid-off
shimmies down and works a length ball to deep square leg for a single
short of a length, wide, cut away in the air to deep point for one
on a length, pretty straight, swinging away, but Conway manages to shuffle across and nudge this to leg for one
steers this to deep third and comes back for two by the time deep point comes around, fields and sends the ball across
short of a length, angling across, runs it down for a single
short-arm pull. Rana looks to tuck him up by bowling it into his ribs, but Conway knows fine leg is up, and he just needs to help this along. Stays inside the line and uses his pace
short of a length, tight line, but Gaikwad manages to run it down behind square on the off side for one
pitches this up, but Gaikwad can't find the gap on the drive. Fielded at extra cover
he has been impressive. Hits the bat high with this length ball
the first dot of the innings. Pitched up, starts just outside off and swings away. Conway has pushed this too well towards point
short of a length, swinging in, gets the bottom edge on the cut but takes the single
tries the change-up. Swings it away, but floats up a wide half-volley, and Gaikwad drives it through square cover for four. Silken
better line, just outside off, swinging away, Conway drops and runs, and makes it easily
swings away but starts too straight, and he plays it with soft hands. It goes forward of square, and they come back for two
big inswinger, runs off the inner half of the bat, gets a single to mid-on
that's the game. Slower ball, but too full, and Rana goes for the drive. Gets a thick edge that clears short third
full and wide, too wide
slower ball, 128ks, Rana beaten as he moves around to manufacture a shot
low full toss as he tries a yorker. Driven to long-on for one
full, leg-stump line, clipped off the toes to deep midwicket for two
makes room to drive this full ball inside-out but can't beat the diving Moeen at short cover
misses the yorker, but a really full ball at 145ks, and it is driven to deep cover for another single
misses the yorker by a small margin. Low full toss driven to deep cover
gets the yorker right, 145ks, on off, dug out to that short cover
this one has gone horribly wrong. Big big wide down the leg side. Dhoni dives to his right. gets a touch on it, but can't prevent five wides
slower ball, 132ks, the bottom hand comes off, the ball goes towards cover but they go for the single. Moeen beats Rinku with a direct hit. Finally a wicket for CSK. Might there be a twist?
short of a length, trying to cramp hi, tucked away to deep midwicket for the sixth single of the over
fifty for Rana as he deflects this length ball into the leg side
carrom ball, quicker, on a length, punched to deep midwicket for a single
slow in the air, middle and leg, offbreak, Rana drops and runs, gets the single
too full, driven inside-out, but can't beat extra cover. Still gets a single
on a length, angling in, worked behind square on the leg side
wow that is a four off a yorker. Not an edge or a steer. But he has dug this out past midwicket for a four all along the ground. Fifty for Rinku
slower ball gone wrong. A high full toss outside off. Called a no-ball, and Dhoni has challenged it. Clearly above the waist. The on-field decision is upheld
another yorker on target, 147ks, and Rana gets a single off the inside edge of the toe of the bat
misses his length a little, and he pas worked this straight of deep backward square for two
another pinpoint yorker. Rana makes room, digs it out, but can't get a single as it goes straight to point
straight yorker, and Rana has to dig it out
wide low full toss, steered to square deep third for one
punches this carrom ball to deep midwicket for another single
on a length, spinning in, no room, defended with an open face
works this around the corner for one
he has placed this length ball between long-on and deep midwicket, and has come back for two
drilled past him. Overpitched, and he has hit this hard, singeing the ground as it goes for a straight four. Under a run a ball now
Rana goes back to a length ball, and cuts it hard. In the air but to the left of short third, and point is too square
looks to use Jadeja's pace by opening the face but can't neat short third
Rinku has punished Jadeja both times that he has flighted the ball. On both occasions he has overpitched, and this time he slog-sweeps him for a six over the big side of the field
driven hard to deep cover for one
quick and straight, punched to long-on
swept in the air, doesn't get all of it, but it doesn't carry to deep square leg
fired in on a length, pushed to short straight midwicket
he inside-outs Moeen again, but the long-off is wider now. Just the single
drift into the pads, beats his inside edge but goes for a leg-bye
fired in now, and Rana works this into the leg side for one
even better as he has taken this from around leg, but still used his wrists to get enough power into this. Goes over extra cover again. Four again
beautiful shot. A bit overpitched, and he makes room to go in side-out over extra cover. Nails it
full, middle and off, driven down to long-off for one
some extra bounce from short of a length, cut away for one
well the moment Jadeja gives it a bit of air - and he overpitches it - Rinku smashes him back over his head for a flat six
another dot as Jadeja stays quick and straight. Pushed to short midwicket
fires this on, on off, played back to Jadeja
fuller and straight, deflected into the leg side for another single
length ball, on the pads, nudged past short fine for one
on a length, into the pads, helped into the leg side for one
down the wicket, beaten in the air as Moeen goes middle and leg. Ends up checking it. Defends
cuts a length ball to deep point
pushed into the covers for one

dropped by Pathirana. Orthodox sweep, gets a top edge, Pathirana runs in from deep square, gets to it, nearly has it, but the ball slips out as he slides down. Just not sweetly in the hand, and when the elbow hits the ground, it comes out
Rana reverses early, and gets enough timing on it. He is deliberately looking to hit it in the air, and clears short third with ease
slower short ball, 131ks, Rinku dabs it wide of Dhoni and fine of deep third. Comes back for two
yorker, 146ks, just outside off. Rana opens the face for a single
bouncer, sharp one at 145ks, and Rana ducks it
just short of a length, just outside off, steered to deep third
full and straight, and Rayudu makes a diving save at short straight midwicket to save one run
wide down the leg side
on a lnegth, outside off, 140ks, late swing away, beats his attempt to dab down on it
into the pads, helped around the corner for one
pitched up now, and defended back to him
goes back to cut a length ball. Really throws his hands at it, and the edge flies over slip for four
Rinku says he can't let Moeen bowl where he wants to. Jumps out of the track, turns this into a half-volley, and drives it along the ground and past extra cover
moves the line to middle and off, but still on the perfect length. Defended back to him
turn from middle and leg. Rinku looking to nudge it to leg, gets a leading edge back to him
looks like the carrom ball. Played straight to short straight cover
quicker, fuller, driven to deep cover
looks to go over extra cover but gets a thick edge that clears the ring and gets him a single
big back lift, length ball , middle and leg. Checks his shot, pushes this to extra cover
full, around off, driven down to long-off
full, outside off, driven to long-off for one
full, middle and leg, makes room to drive it to long-off for one
some turn again, and he defends it off the back foot
has he dropped it?. This one turns from middle and off, and Dhoni fails to collect it. Think it has missed the edge
pushed into the pads, worked to deep midwicket for one
slow in. the air, middle and leg, turns towards off, defended back
into the pads, nudged into the leg side for one
ends the powerplay with a bang. Deshpande just overpitches slightly, and he drives him over mid-off for a six that just clears the boundary
fuller, outside off, pushed wide of point for one
short of a length, angling in, played uppishly to midwicket
pushes a length ball wide of mid-off for one
on a length, angling in, defended back to him
short of a length, on the pads, worked into the leg side for one
short of a length, outside off, bottom edge towards point for one
wide half-volley, driven hard past the diving extra cover for four. All along the ground
short of a length, hardly any room, punched to point

another catch at short third. Slower ball, wide, really full. Roy has picked the slower ball, and looks to drive, but gets an edge healthy enough to carry to short third. Off a slower knuckle ball. Chahar has three wickets in three overs
short of a length, around off, worked to leg for a single
short to Ran again but waist-high short balls won't do. Rana gets inside the line, and plays the pick up pull for a flat low six over long leg. Short side too
on a length, angling across, runs it down to deep third for one
driven square on the up but a full-length dive to his right from Gaikwad at backward point saves three runs
looks to make room and cut this time, but the slower ball takes his bottom edge
beaten on the bottom end on another pull. This is not even a proper shot ball but Roy tries to pull, and it nearly scoots through. Outside off, though
slower ball, hit uppishly and straight to mid-on
wide length ball, steered fine, and they get two as deep point has some work to do

another bouncer, and Rana tries that Raina pull by getting inside the line. Beaten. A brave delivery to bowl after you have bowled the one for the over. Slightly above the shoulder, and you can be no-balled
and unsurprisingly he bowls a bouncer first up to Rana. Too high

wow. Chahar has again got a wicket in a manner you don't really plan. This is short of a length, sufficiently wide for Iyer to throw his hands at it, and he end sup playing it finer than he wants to. Caught at short third of all places
more width from Chahar to Iyer. This is not quite a half-volley but he drives it hard and in front of deep point
short of a length, wide, a flick-cut. Use of wrists to impart power onto it. Pathirana makes a diving save at deep point
down the wicket, punches this length ball to deep point for one
wide half-volley, languidly driven. Aerial and catchable height but in the gap between point and cover
walks at him, this one kicks at it from short of a length. Doesn't look like it is a slower ball. The gun says 128ks. Just sits in the surface. Roy does well to keep it down
slower ball, short, wide, Roy has to adjust and can't beat backward point with the cut
low bounce. Roy done in on the pull but not quite low enough to hit the wicket. Even Dhoni is done in, and hit on the boot
half-volley, close to off, driven straight to mid-off
audacious shot. Walks at him, and pulls the short ball through midwicket. Not even a full-blooded pull. Just a flick with a horizontal bat
back of a length, wicket to wicket, pushed past square leg for two
short, wide down the leg side

Chahar keeps finding ways to take wicket. This is a wide half-volley, just too wide, which means Gurbaz can't quite middle his square-drive, which he has no plans to keep down. There is a deep point in place, and it it going high to him. Deshpande runs to his right to complete the high catch inches inside the boundary. Had the ball been a touch straighter, Gurbaz would have made a better connection and got six
outswinger, just outside off, Gurbaz pushes at it, and is beaten
short of a length, outside off, punched to deep point for one
down the wicket, swings hard, gets an inside edge onto the small unpadded area between the pad and the knee
perfect outswinger, just outside off, and Gurbaz has left it alone
wide down the leg side as Chahar looks for swing from too straight. Just slips it too far down
outswinger, just short of a length, worked to leg for one
